1.consolidated_definition: Sostenimiento ecológico. Diseño de formas de actividad económica que no lleva a la degradación del medio ambiente. En 1989 la World Commission on Environment and Development (Brundtland Commission) articuló la interpretación ecológica del término. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. El plan de uso de terrenos busca garantizar la sostenibilidad (El Nuevo Día, 15-03-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Eco-sustainability. Design of economic activity forms that do not lead to environmental degradation. In 1989, the World Commission on Environment and Development (Brundtland Commission) articulated an ecological interpretation of this term. Adapted Anglicism, commonly used. The land-use plan seeks to ensure sustainability (The New Day, 15-03-07).
